patch.description: Replaces the markdown body of a message authored by the authenticated API-key workspace membership. Each accepted edit marks the message as edited and emits a message.updated ProductEvent to webhook and realtime subscribers. A message posted with a document card can replace that card by sending app_card; the server regenerates its text fallback. Attachments, thread placement, and authorship are fixed at create time and are not editable, and a message without a document card cannot gain one. Sending a body identical to the stored one is a no-op: the message keeps its revision and no event is emitted. Editing does not create new mentions or notifications.

delete.description: Deletes a message authored by the authenticated API-key workspace membership, exactly as its author deleting it in the app: the message is removed for everyone, its body, attachments and reactions are cleared, and replies under a thread root stay in their thread. Requires messages:write. A message that does not exist, is not visible to the key, was authored by someone else, or is already deleted returns 404 Message not found, so repeating a delete is safe and reveals nothing. No webhook event is emitted.

With send_at, the message is scheduled instead and the response is 202 with the scheduled message: it is sent at that time, through the same scheduling the app uses, only if the key is still live and its member can still post there. send_at must be at least 5 minutes and at most 30 days ahead (400 invalid_send_at otherwise); a key holds at most 100 waiting messages (409 scheduled_message_limit_reached).
